description: Granular sample player: grains are cut from one of five loaded samples at a chosen position and spawned at a rate of their own or on an external clock

params.text: Sets how long each grain is, up to 6400 samples
Attenuates the WINDOW CV, from nothing through to its full range
Sets where in the sample new grains begin, from its start to its end
Attenuates the POS CV, from nothing through to its full range
Shifts the playback speed of every grain by a volt per octave, from -2V to 2V
Sets the output level, from silence through unity at 1 to twice the level at 2
Scatters the start position of each new grain, up to three thousand samples either way at the right
Sets how many grains may sound at once, up to 140
Attenuates the GRAINS CV, from nothing through to its full range
Sets how often a new grain is spawned, from a few a second at the left to one per sample at the right
Attenuates the RATE CV, from nothing through to its full range
Picks which of the five loaded samples the grains are cut from
Attenuates the SAMPLE selection CV, from nothing through to its full range

inputs.text: Multiplies the jitter spread by the voltage here, so 0V removes the scatter and 1V gives what the knob is set to
Adds to the grain length after its attenuator, 0-10V covering its full range
Adds to the grain position after its attenuator, 0-10V covering the whole sample
Adds to the playback speed, a volt per octave
A rising edge spawns one grain, and while a cable is patched here the internal spawn rate is not used
Places each new grain in the stereo field, 0V hard left through 5V centre to 10V hard right
Adds to the grain count after its attenuator, 0-10V covering none to 140
Adds to the spawn rate after its attenuator, 0-10V covering its full range
Adds to the sample selection after its attenuator, 0-10V spanning the five samples

outputs.text: The left channel of the grain cloud
The right channel of the grain cloud

notes: the outputs stay silent until a WAV file is loaded into one of the five slots under Samples in the right-click menu
menu: Samples — the five numbered items under this label each load a WAV file into that slot, and each prints the filename it holds

inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.3: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.4: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.6:
0 to 10V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.7:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.8:
0 to 10V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
